name: sidebar-14
title: Sidebar 14
description: A sidebar on the right: the page comes first and the pad hangs from the other edge as a table of contents, folding away with a button at the far end of the header. Mirrors shadcn's sidebar-14. Looks right on the desk and on plain paper.

( {heading.items.map((item) => ( {item.title} ))} ) : null} ))} ) }

import { AppSidebar } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-14/components/sidebar-14-app-sidebar"
import { containedClasses } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-contained"
import { docsTrail } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-data"
import { PageBody, PageHeader, PageNote, PageSheet } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-page"
import { SidebarProvider } from "@/components/ui/sidebar"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

export default function Page({ contained = false }: { contained?: boolean }) {
  const c = containedClasses(contained)
  return (
    <SidebarProvider className={cn("overflow-x-clip", c.provider)}>
      <PageSheet className={c.inset}>
        <PageHeader crumbs={docsTrail} trigger="end" bordered />
        <PageBody title="Margins" kicker="Writing on paper">
          <PageNote title="Read it from the right" pose="peek">
            The pad on this side lists what is on the page. Fold it away with the button in the corner when you would rather just read.
          </PageNote>
        </PageBody>
      </PageSheet>
      <AppSidebar side="right" className={c.sidebar} />
    </SidebarProvider>
  )
}
